about.title: About
about.description: Fullstack developer and illustrator, I combine technical rigor and artistic creativity.
about.pullQuote2: between two screens: a terminal and a sketchbook.
about.bodyP1: Fullstack developer for 3 years, specializing in microservices architecture (Rust, GraphQL, Next.js). Coming from a nurse → dev career change in 2022, I've developed a rigorous and collaborative approach to software development. Drawn to complex technical challenges and continuous improvement.
about.bodyP2: The other half of my life fits on an A4 sheet and a brush. I've been drawing since childhood, mainly in watercolor and digital. I publish humorous comics on Instagram as @louise.maviepassionnante, I've illustrated a children's book, and created educational comics for a medical laboratory.
about.bodyP3: This site is a personal magazine. Six rubrics, a cover, a contents page, a letters section. It's more honest than the usual portfolio, and it looks more like me. Two worlds that come together here, side by side.
about.bodyP4: Currently open to new opportunities in the Paris area, I'm looking for projects where technical rigor and creativity can coexist.
